theorems.name: Submission.doragm_sab_exp_ratio_compare
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (c K s t : ℝ) (I I' G G' J h : ℝ → ℝ), 0 ≤ c → 0 < s → s < t → (∀ τ ∈ Icc s t, HasDerivAt I (I' τ) τ) → (∀ τ ∈ Icc s t, HasDerivAt G (G' τ) τ) → (∀ τ ∈ Icc s t, (n : ℝ) * I τ - τ * I' τ + τ * J τ = -h τ) → (∀ τ ∈ Icc s t, |h τ| ≤ c * τ * I τ) → (∀ τ ∈ Icc s t, 0 ≤ J τ) → (∀ τ ∈ Icc s t, G' τ ≤ J τ / τ ^ n) → (∀ τ ∈ Icc s t, J τ / τ ^ n ≤ K * G' τ) → G t - G s ≤ Real.exp (c * t) / t ^ n * I t - Real.exp (c * s) / s ^ n * I s ∧ Real.exp (-(c * t)) / t ^ n * I t - Real.exp (-(c * s)) / s ^ n * I s ≤ K * (G t - G s)
